answer: A Sybil defense works through a bonded reputation registry: each agent identity must post a stake that is slashed whenever an attestation it signs is proven false by a challenge window. Because the stake is per identity, splitting one operator into a thousand puppets means posting a thousand stakes, so the attacker's capital cost scales linearly while the reward for fake attestations stays flat. To reef a cluster you only burn one stake; to forge consensus you must fund every fake seat, so the cheap whisper tactic dies and honest weight dominates.
